newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean bond yields end at another new 1997 low.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean bond yields end at another new 1997 low.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds closed at a new 1997 low of 11.52 percent on Thursday, buoyed by ample liquidity in the market, traders said.
This was the lowest level since June 13, 1996, when the yields dropped to 11.50 percent.
Three-month cerficates of deposit (CD) yields also dropped to another new yearly low of 11.70 percent.
The market will be closed on Friday for a national holiday and will reopen on Saturday.
